svg.text: Target design, not yet deployed. Purple lines follow evidence from its source to a mapped control and an audit package.
Config, Security Hub, and CloudTrail feed Audit Manager assessments for each framework.
A daily Scheduler run and Config or Audit Manager change events start the evidence collector.
The collector writes timestamped, hashed evidence to a temporary S3 lake (no Object Lock).
The mapper links each evidence object to its controls in the DynamoDB control map.
The package builder reads the control map and assembles a per audit evidence bundle.
The auditor receives the audit package with read-only access.
Glue catalogs the evidence lake so the auditor can query by control in Athena.
CloudWatch alarms when a control has no new evidence inside its window and alerts the owner through SNS.
